title.narrative: Yemen Integrated Urban Services Emergency Project YIUSEP (Phase II)

description.narrative: The development objective of the Integrated Urban Services Emergency Project for Yemen is to restore access to critical urban services in selected cities within the Republic of Yemen. The project will finance activities that support the restoration of critical urban services in selected Yemeni cities. The restoration of urban services, including water and sanitation, transport, energy and solid waste management, will be critical to improve health outcomes, basic living conditions and local economic activity. The project adopts an integrated approach to urban service delivery that provides coordinated, multi-sectoral support to Yemen during the conflict.
